name: HubSpot Speed-to-Lead SLA Breach Root-Cause Latency Profiler (Safe-by-Default)

parameters.content:
## Speed-to-Lead SLA Breach Root-Cause Profiler

**Safe by default.** With no env vars this runs in **SANDBOX_MODE** on a synthetic fixture (portal 99000001): zero network calls, nothing posted, no CRM updates. Slack / Teams payloads appear in **Dry-Run Preview**.

Go-live needs explicit opt-ins:
`SANDBOX_MODE=false` · `DRY_RUN=false` · `NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED=true` (+ webhook URL in env, host allowlisted) · optional `HUBSPOT_MUTATIONS_ENABLED=true` (SLA fields on contacts).

Fail-closed: failed / truncated searches abort; anomaly ratio blocks posting. Only timestamps, owner IDs and lead source are fetched. Secrets only via `$env`. See README.md.

nodes.name: SLA Profiler Webhook
nodes.notes: POST {"as_of":"2026-11-16T10:00:00Z","window_hours":168} (both optional) with header x-sla-secret (required in live mode).

nodes.name: Weekly Schedule (Mon 07:53)
nodes.notes: Mondays 07:53 in the instance time zone. Ships inactive.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Env-only config, fail-safe flags, window, SLA budgets + clock, webhook auth, notification allowlist.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Leads in Window
nodes.notes: Read-only contact search (timestamps, owner, source only). Stops the run on failure.

nodes.name: Collect Lead Pages
nodes.notes: Fail closed on errors, >10k results or truncated pagination.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Fetch Owners
nodes.notes: Optional owner display names; failure falls back to owner IDs.

nodes.name: Latency Profiler
nodes.notes: Timestamp validation, hop latency (wall / business clock), SLA status, root cause, percentiles, bottleneck, guards.

nodes.name: Notification Builder
nodes.notes: Slack Block Kit + Teams Adaptive Card; duplicate-post guard.

nodes.name: Post Slack / Teams Update
nodes.notes: Webhook URLs read from $env only. No automatic retry (no duplicate posts).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Update Contact SLA Fields
nodes.notes: The ONLY CRM write: sla_status, sla_root_cause, sla_speed_to_lead_minutes, sla_analyzed_at.
